The evidence suggests that Ubenimex targets Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 2B1, which in turn is targeted by a specific organic compound. This compound, methyl (1R,4S,5R,9S,10S,13R,15S)-15-acetyloxy-5,9-dimethyl-14-methylidenetetracyclo[11.2.1.01,10.04,9]hexadecane-5-carboxylate, is known to interact with Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1. The presence of a final score of 0.5583 indicates a moderate level of confidence in this relationship. The mechanism appears to involve a direct interaction between Ubenimex and the transporter, potentially modulating its activity and affecting the transport of organic anions across cellular membranes. This interaction may underlie the observed effects of Ubenimex on the target transporter, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the exact nature of the interaction.
